talks.title: Run the extra mile with serverless
talks.description: sennder is migration from monolith to microservices. We will explain the requirements and architecture that they're working on, and see some live coding on how to consume Kafka events using AWS Lambda.

talks.title: Creating Python Data Pipelines with Yaetos
talks.description: The talk will describe the challenges of creating python data pipelines and putting them in production in the cloud, and how Yaetos can help. It is targeted at data engineers, data scientists, analysts and python enthusiasts. Yaetos is a data framework, simplifying the use of Apache Spark in the AWS cloud, and with implementations in production at Infojobs and The Hotels Network.

talks.title: From text to actions: LLMs as the new software consumers
talks.description: QA bots, copilots, workflow automation - LLMs are evolving to control our software through natural language. The endgame is APIs. LLMs that can convert user intents directly into HTTP requests, like Talk2Apis does today, will have the flexibility to access any service. This creates a machine-first software economy with big implications for developers. Python examples included.

talks.title: Ragtime: An Approach to Retrieval-Augmented Generation
talks.description: In this session, we'll explore a pattern that has sparked significant interest in the world of natural language models (LLMs): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We'll walk through a practical implementation, dive into its details, and share insights based on our experiences working with these methods. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we encourage you to join—what matters most is your interest in LLMs, machine learning, and engineering, and how to leverage these technologies to bring value to your company or organization.

talks.title: Feedback immediat per estudiants de programació: Powered by Python
talks.description: Presentació d'una eina per a l'ensenyament de la programació, creada per minimitzar el temps entre la resolució de l'exercici i la recepció de la retroacció. L'eina ha estat desenvolupada al llarg dels anys en paral·lel al seu ús a l'aula, sota pressió per terminis ajustats, canvis de temari i estudiants amb imaginació per trobar maneres enginyoses d'enganyar el sistema. El resultat és una història de compromisos i solucions creatives, des de prohibir funcionalitats concretes del llenguatge fins a l'ús exclusiu de tecnologies gratuïtes.

talks.title: Python-powered Cybersecurity Lab: Caldera, Elastic Stack & ATT&CK simluation
talks.description: En esta charla mostraremos un laboratorio completo de ciberseguridad compuesto por máquinas virtuales, Elastic Stack y el framework MITRE Caldera (Python). A través de una demostración guiada, analizaremos cómo simular técnicas del framework MITRE ATT&CK y cómo correlacionarlas en tiempo real con logs de sistemas Linux para detectar comportamiento malicioso.
